## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation validator should adopt the new minimum because it still accepts eight- to eleven-character passwords. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimums from eight to twelve characters, updates their boundary tests, and adds reviewer-facing text.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Apply the twelve-character minimum to invitations — After you raise signup’s minimum to twelve, an invitation password of `xxxxxxxx` still passes the unchanged validator at `app/invite.py:1`, violating the stated password requirement. `tests/test_invite.py:8` still expects acceptance at eight characters. — Users choosing passwords through invitations can bypass the new twelve-character minimum. — Fix: Update `app/invite.py:1` and extend `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py` for the twelve-character boundary.

(none)
